config.title: Processing Settings
config.hint: Choose a model, tempo, and quantization settings.
config.backend_help: Used for full mixes and post-separation track conversion
config.muscriptor_instruments_help: Leave empty for automatic detection, or select the instruments to include. Suggestions based on the filename can be changed.
config.muscriptor_chain_help: Standard uses the model’s original segment handling. Sustain across segments joins sustained notes across segment boundaries. Tempo is set separately.
config.track_layout_help: Multi-track keeps model groups; single-track merges the layout
config.tempo_help: Auto uses the detected constant BPM. Follow source uses detected tempo changes. Manual uses the BPM you set.
config.bpm_help: Used in manual mode; the MIDI contains one tempo event
config.quantize_notes_help: Snap note starts and durations on all tracks to the selected grid; off by default
config.quantize_grid_help: Quantization grid for this conversion; default: 1/32
config.compute_help: Full workflows require NVIDIA CUDA or Intel XPU; CPU is outside the supported runtime
action.delete_job_confirm: Delete this job, its track child jobs, and every retained input/output file? This cannot be undone.
result.title: Processing result
result.completed: MIDI is ready to download and play.
result.separation_completed: The WAV stems are ready; each track can be converted to MIDI separately.
result.failed: Processing failed and no file is available to download.
result.cancelled: The job stopped; incomplete files are not offered for download.
result.failure_help: The error above identifies the cause. Processing can be tried again after the environment or settings are corrected.
result.cancelled_help: The original audio remains available to process again or delete.
result.sheet_music_ready: The score ZIP is ready and its download has started.
result.warning.empty_midi: The MIDI file is valid, but the selected model did not detect any notes.
result.warning.note_count_corrected_from: The displayed note count was recalculated from the final MIDI file.
result.warning.help: The file remains downloadable. Listening to it can help determine whether another model better suits this track.
